work_qa._comment: Work boards QA report config. One report across every key in jira_workspaces.work; board filter is client-side. Checks run in listed order; only failing checks render in a row's QA cell.

checks.name: Child of a closed parent
checks.rule: Open task or sub-task whose parent is Done.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="1.8" y="1.8" width="6.4" height="5" rx="1"/><path d="M3.4 4.3l1 1 1.8-1.9"/><path d="M5 6.8v4.4h3"/><rect x="8" y="9.2" width="6.2" height="4.4" rx="1"/></g>

checks.name: Delivery for a closed idea
checks.rule: Linked to a roadmap idea that’s Done or Canceled.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5.8 11.2c0-1.4-2.3-2.6-2.3-5.1a4.5 4.5 0 0 1 9 0c0 2.5-2.3 3.7-2.3 5.1z"/><path d="M6.2 13.4h3.6"/><path d="M6.3 6.3l1.2 1.2 2.2-2.4"/></g>

checks.name: Empty epic
checks.rule: Open epic with no open children.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9.2 1.8 3.6 9h4l-1 5.2L12.4 7h-4z"/></g>

checks.name: Stalled on us
checks.rule: Started, our move, no update in 30+ days.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 1.8h8M4 14.2h8"/><path d="M4.8 1.8v2.4c0 1.6 3.2 2.6 3.2 3.8S4.8 10.2 4.8 11.8v2.4M11.2 1.8v2.4c0 1.6-3.2 2.6-3.2 3.8s3.2 2.2 3.2 3.8v2.4"/><path d="M6.4 12.6h3.2"/></g>

checks.name: Blocker cleared
checks.rule: “Is blocked by” an item that’s now Done.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="7.2" width="10" height="7" rx="1.4"/><path d="M5.4 7.2V5a2.6 2.6 0 0 1 5-1"/><path d="M8 10v1.6"/></g>

checks.name: Started, unassigned
checks.rule: Our move or vendor’s move with no assignee.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="6.4" cy="5.2" r="2.6"/><path d="M1.8 14c0-2.7 2-4.6 4.6-4.6 1 0 1.9.3 2.6.8"/><path d="M11.4 9.6v4.4M9.2 11.8h4.4"/></g>

checks.name: Past due date
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="3.2" width="12" height="10.8" rx="1.6"/><path d="M2 6.6h12"/><path d="M5.2 1.6v3M10.8 1.6v3"/><path d="M8 8.6v2"/><path d="M8 12.4h.01" stroke-width="2"/></g>

checks.name: Vendor release passed
checks.rule: With the vendor, tagged for a release before this month.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 1.8 13.8 4.8v6.4L8 14.2 2.2 11.2V4.8z"/><path d="M2.2 4.8 8 7.8l5.8-3M8 7.8v6.4"/></g>

checks.name: No vendor ticket ID
checks.rule: With the vendor but the vendor ticket ID is empty.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8.7 2H14v5.3l-6.6 6.6a1 1 0 0 1-1.4 0L2.1 10a1 1 0 0 1 0-1.4z"/></g><circle cx="11.3" cy="4.7" r="1.1" fill="currentColor"/>

checks.name: Blocked or on hold
checks.rule: Status is Blocked or On Hold.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5.4 1.8h5.2l3.6 3.6v5.2l-3.6 3.6H5.4l-3.6-3.6V5.4z"/><path d="M5.2 8h5.6"/></g>

checks.name: Assignee not in directory
checks.rule: Assigned to someone not found in the Slack directory; likely a former employee.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="6.4" cy="5.2" r="2.6"/><path d="M1.8 14c0-2.7 2-4.6 4.6-4.6 1 0 1.9.3 2.6.8"/><path d="M10.2 10.2l3.6 3.6M13.8 10.2l-3.6 3.6"/></g>

checks.name: Assigned outside Technology
checks.rule: Assignee is active but not on the Technology roster.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="6.4" cy="5.2" r="2.6"/><path d="M1.8 14c0-2.7 2-4.6 4.6-4.6 1 0 1.9.3 2.6.8"/><path d="M10 12h4.2M12.4 10.2l1.8 1.8-1.8 1.8"/></g>

checks.name: Backlog rot
checks.rule: To Do, 180+ days old, untouched for 90+ days.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="1.8" y="2.6" width="12.4" height="3.4" rx="1"/><path d="M2.8 6v6.4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h8.4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V6"/><path d="M6.4 8.8h3.2"/></g>

verdicts.title: Close the loop
verdicts.cap: The parent or roadmap idea is already closed, or the epic has nothing open under it. Usually a quick close.

verdicts.title: Vendor commitments at risk
verdicts.cap: With the vendor and past the release it was tagged for, or missing the vendor’s ticket ID.

verdicts.title: Reassign
verdicts.cap: Assigned to someone who has likely left, or to someone outside the Technology team. Confirm the owner, then reassign or close.

verdicts.title: Blocked
verdicts.cap: Status is Blocked or On Hold, or the issue it was blocked by is now done.

verdicts.title: Stalled on us
verdicts.cap: Started, our move, and no update in 30+ days, past due, or unassigned. Oldest update first.

verdicts.title: Backlog to groom
verdicts.cap: To Do items that are 180+ days old and untouched for 90+, or past their due date. Candidates to archive or reschedule.

verdicts.title: No issues found
verdicts.cap: Moving, or with the vendor and inside its release window.

palette._comment: Hex values from signatry-brand-core. Light / dark pairs.

queries.jql: project in (TT, GE, DVR, HSER, IL) AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY project ASC, created ASC
queries.description: Every open item on the work boards, team-wide. Excluded statuses are dropped in Python so the report can count them.
